ResearchTabDef.label: Tribal
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: The first steps of a people with nothing: fire, tools, gathering and the knowledge passed between them. Finish the era's capstone to enter the neolithic.

ResearchTabDef.label: Neolithic
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Farming, herding and settled life. Finish the era's capstone to enter the medieval era.

ResearchTabDef.label: Medieval
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Stonecutting, smithing and the crafts of a settled society. Finish the era's capstone to enter the industrial era.

ResearchTabDef.label: Industrial
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Electricity, machinery and firearms. Finish the era's capstone to enter the spacer era.

ResearchTabDef.label: Spacer
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: The technology of the stars: fabrication, advanced medicine and spaceflight.

ResearchTabDef.label: Ultra
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Technology at the edge of understanding.
